card.name: Dots in section numbers
card.fires_on: The period or digit inside a numbered section heading such as 2.1 or 7.1, right after the main section number. It is most common in drug label section headings and cross-references in parentheses.

modes.label: Label subsection numbers
modes.description: The dot after a main section number (2, 4, 7) at the start of a subsection in a drug label.
modes.example: 2. DOSAGE & ADMINISTRATION 2<<.>>1 General Dosing Instructions Use Xic

modes.label: Parenthetical section references
modes.description: The dot in a cross-reference to a section, written in parentheses in the label highlights.

card.writes: It lowers Roman numeral tokens such as II, III and IV, which suggests the next token is an Arabic subsection digit, not a Roman numeral.
card.plain: It marks the point inside a section number like 2.1 where a subsection digit comes next.
